title: Text and writing rules
slide_intent: Teach editors to distinguish a work’s title from surrounding prose and present historical dates in a consistent form.
strategic_value: A shared editorial treatment can make information about different exhibitions feel like part of one publication.
demonstration: Rules for centuries, decades and spacing sit beside rules for titles in prose and credits. A publication spread shows how text and artworks fit together.
practical_value: Use italics for exhibition and artwork titles in body copy, check hyphenation on adjectival centuries and omit the apostrophe from decades.

content_islands.name: Titles in context
content_islands.spec: Set the title guidance and a paragraph example beside the first column. Show how a title appears inside a sentence.
